final: WITH p AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS a FROM orderexecutions WHERE fillcount IS NOT NULL AND fillcount <> 0 GROUP BY ordersmark), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM p), k AS (SELECT a, a - (SELECT m FROM b1) AS e1 FROM p WHERE a > (SELECT m FROM b1)), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM k), f AS (SELECT a, e1, a - (SELECT m FROM b2) AS e2 FROM k WHERE a > (SELECT m FROM b2)) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_fill, AVG(e1) AS avg_first_excess, AVG(e2) AS avg_second_excess FROM f
